description:
Tourist and locals in Budapest spoke to Reuters as Hungary switched off decorative and non-essential lighting at all state institutions at night. Record-low water levels on the Danube forced the country to largely shut down its sole nuclear plant, which uses the river for cooling, stretching power supply capacity to its limits.

The Democratic Party's progressive wing scored a high-profile victory when Abdul El-Sayed won the party's U.S. Senate nomination in Michigan, giving its anti-establishment message a boost ahead of November's midterm elections. "I'd just like to congratulate Doctor Abdul El-Sayed on his victory," said New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani.
